title: Food Process
summary:
Food Process & Machine Operator – Carole Park location

What’s the gig?
We’re Recruit Masters, the blue-collar specialists who know our way around a production line as well as you do. Right now, our food-manufacturing clients (think household names) need switched-on operators to keep the lines humming across their Carole Park site.

Day to day
* Setting up, running and tweaking high-speed processing & packing machinery
* Handling raw meat on halal-certified lines 
* Quality checks that’d make your mum proud – temp, weight, seals, the works
* Cleaning & sanitising gear so the food-safety auditors stay happy
* Teaming up with crew and supervisors to smash shift targets safely

Shift options
✅Day shifts:kick-off anywhere between 4 am – 7 am
✅Arvo shifts:start around 1:30 pm
✅Lock in a regular roster – show us you’re reliable 

You’ll fit right in if you…
✅Have previous food-processing or machine-operating experience (bonus points for both)
✅Can lift up to \~25 kg and stay on your feet all shift
✅Understand HACCP/GMP basics – or are keen to learn fast
✅Can pass a pre-employment medical, drug & alcohol test and reference checks
✅Bring great attitude, solid work ethic, and zero drama – simple!

Why jump on board?
* Steady hours with overtime when production peaks
* Work with industry-leading brands (looks good on the résumé)
* Supportive supervisors, and genuine pathways to permanent hire 
* Weekly pay and occasional!

Sound like your next move?
Apply Now or contact us directly to secure your spot.

title: Forklift Operator
summary:
We’re Hiring: High Reach Forklift Operators | Richlands 
Afternoon Shift | Ongoing Work

Join a nationally recognised company that’s growing like crazy! We’re on the lookout for skilled High Reach Forklift Operators to jump into an awesome team based at a state-of-the-art facility in Richlands.

 Shift: Monday to Friday, 1:30pm – 9:36pm
 PPE Required: Hi-vis (vest or polo), steel caps – standard safety gear

 ✅ What You’ll Need:
- Current Forklift Licence
- At least 12 months' experience on High Reach (Jungheinrich or Yale experience is a bonus!)
- A good team vibe – you'll be working closely with others

✅ What You’ll Be Doing:
- Driving High Reach Forklifts (Jungheinrich & Yale)
- Picking and packing orders
- Loading containers for dispatch
- Working hand-in-hand with the Manufacturing team

✅ Perks of the Job:
- Work in a modern, purpose-built warehouse
- Easy location in Richlands with plenty of free onsite parking
- Break room with free coffee machine, food vending machines & big screen TVs
- Designated smokers area

title: HC Truck Driver
summary:

Benefits of the Job:

Monday-Friday 7.00am - 3.00pm 
Consistent and Ongoing shift
Progression to permanent role with client  
What we are looking for:

A passion and  commitment to safe, efficient driving practices
A keen eye for detail and a proactive approach to yard work, moving trucks in and out of the wash bay and into their designated parking spots
A flexible and adaptable mindset, ready to tackle a range of tasks, from minimal off-road work to nearby site visits

A current HC/MC license.
Extensive experience operating HC-class vehicles, with a strong understanding of their unique handling and performance characteristics.
Excellent communication skills, enabling you to collaborate effectively with our team and respond promptly to any requests or concerns

A solutions-oriented mindset, able to think on your feet and adapt to changing circumstances with ease
A keen eye for detail and a proactive approach to maintaining the  organisation of our vehicle fleet

title: Truck Washer
summary:
We are currently seeking a Truck Washer to join our team! The ideal candidate will be responsible for cleaning trucks and heavy vehicles using high-pressure washers and cleaning equipment.
 ✅ Responsibilities:
Wash and clean the exterior of trucks using a high-pressure cleaner
Maintain a clean and organized wash area
Ensure all vehicles are cleaned to a high standard
Inspect vehicles for any damage or areas requiring extra attention
Follow safety procedures and use personal protective equipment (PPE) as required
✅ Requirements:
Experience using a high-pressure cleaner (preferred, but not essential – training provided)
Physically fit and able to work in outdoor conditions
Reliable, punctual, and hardworking
Ability to work independently or as part of a team
Attention to detail and strong work ethic
✅ What We Offer:
Competitive hourly rate
Supportive and friendly team environment
On-the-job training
Opportunities for advancement
